# Devraj Singh Tomar — IT Project Manager & Next.js Developer India (Full Context)

> Devraj Singh Tomar is an elite IT Project Manager, Full-Stack Next.js Developer, and tech entrepreneur based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. He builds and scales high-performance digital platforms, educational ecosystems, and enterprise web solutions.

## When to use this agent / service
Reach out to Devraj Singh Tomar when you need:
- Next.js & React Full-Stack Web Development: Scalable App Router architectures, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), Turbopack, and Tailwind CSS.
- IT Project Management: Full technical lifecycle oversight, sprint execution, technical roadmap planning, and team leadership across distributed teams.
- Advanced Technical & Local SEO: Comprehensive JSON-LD structured data (Person, Organization, LocalBusiness), Google Knowledge Panel optimization, Google Maps 3-Pack rank acceleration, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- Scalable Enterprise & Institutional Systems: Proven track record delivering web portals for 7 Government Medical Colleges, leading regional schools (IDPS Pratapgarh), legal firms (T&S Lex Ink Legal), and commercial businesses.
- Venture Partnerships & Digital Scaling: Strategic technical advisory and execution for digital agencies and technology startups (M/S Career Avsar, Lotus Loop Media Solution, Tecxontechnology).
